First, we write out the inner summation by summing over the index $j:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{\sum }_{i=1}^{3}{\sum }_{j=1}^{3}(i-j) & ={\sum }_{i=1}^{3}[{\sum }_{j=1}^{3}(i-j)] \\  & ={\sum }_{i=1}^{3}((i-1)+(i-2)+(i-3)) \\  & ={\sum }_{i=1}^{3}(3i-6)\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we sum over the index $i:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{\sum }_{i=1}^{3}(3i-6) & =(3\cdot 1-6)+(3\cdot 2-6)+(3\cdot 3-6) \\  & =-3+0+3 \\  & =0\end{aligned}
$$
